title: Hazard Perception Handbook
summary: Use the Hazard Perception Handbook to improve your hazard perception skills and drive more safely.
intro:
Use the Hazard Perception Handbook to develop your hazard perception skills and drive more safely.

The Hazard Perception Handbook can help you develop hazard perception skills that will make you a safer driver and prepare you for the Hazard Perception Test (HPT).

The handbook should help you to detect and react to any hazards that might arise when you are driving.
